notes.title: STAR OCEAN THE SECOND STORY R is coming Nov 2nd, 2023. Pre-purchase is now open!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238900/STAR_OCEAN_THE_SECOND_STORY_R/

This has finally been announced! Widely considered one of the best games of the series, this beloved RPG is being completely remade in a unique 2.5D aesthetic and coming on November 2nd for the first time on Steam! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365396/17e755b4c69031054a522451ccc5cc00b6a7fff5.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=Bp7svshy_NQ;full][/previewyoutube]

In a lonely corner of space, Claude, a Federation officer, finds himself transported to a mystical planet. While searching for a way home, an encounter with a young girl, Rena, draws him into a quest to save her people, just as an ancient prophecy foretold... Start your journey with either Claude or Rena, and witness an awaken destiny.

Experience new battle mechanics, full Japanese and English voice overs, original and re-arranged music with many new elements! [url=https://weblet.square-enix.com/geojmp.php?d=BLOG&l=STAR-OCEAN-SECOND-STORY-R]Read more details in the official blog here[/url].

Pre-purchase to obtain the following digital content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365396/ba9f7eaf5693eb2b4fac8cfd30aade334ee18b60.png[/img]Pangalactic Federation Longsword (exclusive weapon for Claude)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365396/ba9f7eaf5693eb2b4fac8cfd30aade334ee18b60.png[/img]Forest Knuckles ((exclusive weapon for Rena)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365396/ba9f7eaf5693eb2b4fac8cfd30aade334ee18b60.png[/img]Sunrise Ring**
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38365396/ba9f7eaf5693eb2b4fac8cfd30aade334ee18b60.png[/img]Set of recovery items** (Mixed berries x20 + Resurrection Potion x20)

Be sure to follow us for all the latest STAR OCEAN THE SECOND STORY R news on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram. 

*Available to users who pre-purchase the game before 8:59am PDT on November 2nd, 2023.
**Also available for customers who purchase the game by 8:59am PST on November 16th, 2023.

notes.title: Shader Cache issue resolved: multi-byte letters in OS username + NVIDIA GPUs
notes.content:
The issue regarding the inability to create shader cache when using multi-byte letters for OS username while also using NVIDIA GPUs has been resolved with the latest graphics driver “Release 525 Driver for Windows, Version 526.98.”

If you have been affected by this issue, please try updating the graphics driver in order to resolve this issue. 

Please also make sure to re-compile the shader after the update.

The shader can be re-compiled by following steps:
1. Start the game
2. Go to “System” menu from title screen
3. Go to “Graphics” option, scroll down to “Pre-compiled Shaders” and set it to “ON”
4. Restart the game
5. The shader compilation will now start
*The ”Pre-compiled shader” option will turned OFF after compilation process completed

notes.title: STAR OCEAN THE DIVINE FORCE is available now!
notes.content:
[b]◆ Early Purchase Bonuses[/b]
Pawns (game pieces) that can be used in the mini game, Es'owa. Can also be used as items of equipment.
Obtain pawns modelled on characters from Valkyrie Profile and Radiata Stories, games also developed by tri-Ace!
・Mini game Pawn: Lenneth (from Valkyrie Profile)
・Mini game Pawn: Lezard (from Valkyrie Profile)
・Mini game Pawn: Jack (from Radiata Stories)
・Mini game Pawn: Ridley (from Radiata Stories)

--------------------------------------------

[b]Fly around areas freely[/b]
In STAR OCEAN THE DIVINE FORCE, characters can move freely in 360 degrees and fly through the sky. 

[b]Move and explore freely in three dimensions – everything you can see is part of the adventure![/b] 
You can move in three dimensions as you fly around the largest field areas yet. 
Whether you’re flying around and exploring rockfaces and roofs of buildings, or leaping from cliffs to seamlessly enter battle, you’ll have more freedom than ever in your approach to both adventuring and combat. 

[b]The fastest and strongest action in the series[/b] 
The freedom in the gameplay experience has also allowed battles to evolve.
Characters can subdue a large number of enemies at once, with super high-speed attacks, an action that allows you to vanish momentarily from under your enemies’ eyes, and special abilities that can defeat enemies in one fell swoop.
STAR OCEAN THE DIVINE FORCE offers a satisfying, thrilling combat experience as you soar freely between the land and the skies.
